description: Traduction français → anglais : s'intensifier, s'aggraver, faire confiance à, atténuer, retirer, le retrait, empêcher, les factions belligérantes, les artisans de la paix, les soldats de la paix, les casques bleus, la zone tampon, le cessez-le-feu, les zones ravagées par la guerre, le nettoyage ethnique, la réconciliation, les sanctions économiques, la dissuasion nucléaire, durable, l'inégalité entre les sexes, l'assainissement, les maladies infectieuses, se disloquer.

questions.question: s'intensifier, s'aggraver
questions.explication: *The conflict could quickly **escalate**.* — Nom : *escalation* (escalade).

questions.question: faire confiance à
questions.explication: *You can **trust** her with this mission.* — Sans préposition : *trust somebody*.

questions.question: atténuer
questions.explication: *Trees help **mitigate** the effects of heatwaves.*

questions.question: (se) retirer (1/2 — commence par **w**)
questions.explication: *The army **withdrew** from the city.* — Traductions : *withdraw*, *pull out*. — Verbe irrégulier : *withdraw – withdrew – withdrawn*.

questions.question: le retrait
questions.explication: *The **withdrawal** of troops began in May.*

questions.question: empêcher
questions.explication: *Vaccines **prevent** many diseases.* — Faux ami : *prevent* = empêcher, pas « prévenir » (= *warn*).

questions.question: les factions belligérantes
questions.explication: *The **warring factions** signed a truce.*

questions.question: les artisans de la paix
questions.explication: *Diplomats are often the real **peacemakers**.* — *peacemakers* négocient la paix ; *peacekeepers* la maintiennent sur le terrain.

questions.question: les soldats de la paix
questions.explication: *UN **peacekeepers** patrol the border.* — Ne pas confondre avec *peacemakers* (artisans de la paix).

questions.question: les casques bleus
questions.explication: *The **blue helmets** arrived in the village yesterday.*

questions.question: la zone tampon
questions.explication: *A **buffer zone** separates the two armies.*

questions.question: le cessez-le-feu
questions.explication: *The **ceasefire** was broken after two days.*

questions.question: les zones ravagées par la guerre
questions.explication: *Children in **war-torn areas** need schools.*

questions.question: le nettoyage ethnique
questions.explication: *The tribunal investigated cases of **ethnic cleansing**.*

questions.question: la réconciliation
questions.explication: ***Reconciliation** between the two communities will take years.*

questions.question: les sanctions économiques
questions.explication: ***Economic sanctions** hit the country's banks.*

questions.question: la dissuasion nucléaire
questions.explication: ***Nuclear deterrence** is at the heart of French defence policy.*

questions.question: durable
questions.explication: *We need a more **sustainable** way of life.* — Faux ami : *durable* en anglais = solide, résistant.

questions.question: l'inégalité entre les sexes
questions.explication: ***Gender inequality** is still a problem in many armies.*

questions.question: l'assainissement
questions.explication: *Clean water and **sanitation** save lives.*

questions.question: les maladies infectieuses
questions.explication: ***Infectious diseases** spread quickly in crowded camps.*

questions.question: se disloquer
questions.explication: *Yugoslavia **broke apart** in the early 1990s.* — Verbe irrégulier : *break – broke – broken*.
